dc:description: One saved identified-connection share for one ownership population, credential population, connection definition and institute.
dc:title: Funding reach
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: result_id: DEP3_observed_reach.result_id; value: DEP3_observed_reach.estimate_percent; probability: DEP3_observed_reach.estimate_probability; numerator: DEP3_observed_reach.numerator; denominator: DEP3_observed_reach.denominator; source_interval_status: DEP3_observed_reach.interval_status; source_base_status: DEP3_observed_reach.denominator_status; interval_status: literal not_computed; interval_unavailable_reason: literal observed_description_no_interval; value_status: available for positive base and nonblank estimate; otherwise unavailable; unavailable_reason: null when available; zero_denominator, unavailable_denominator, or not_provided_in_released_source when unavailable
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
